newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 14.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 14. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Parts of Java and Bali islands suffered an electricity black out on Sunday because of a technical problem in the Suralaya power plant in West Java. The state-owned electricity company PLN has ruled out sabotage as a cause.

Controversial Moslem leader Abdurrahman Wahid has denied helping President Suharto's daughter Siti Hardianti Rukmana campaign for the ruling Golkar party. Wahid is the leader of Indonesia's largest Moslem organisation Nahdlatul Ulama and has been known as a government critic.
The chairman of the ruling Golkar party, Harmoko, has called on party members to shun violent acts before and during the election campaign. Indonesia holds general elections on May 29.
